company.name: Razorpay
company.description: Razorpay is an Indian full-stack financial solutions company that provides payment gateway, payouts, subscriptions, and banking/finance products to businesses. Founded in 2014, Razorpay supports multiple payment methods (cards, UPI, netbanking, wallets) and developer-friendly APIs.

pricing_summary: Razorpay uses a pay-as-you-go pricing model with no setup fees for standard plans. Transaction fees vary by payment method and plan; Razorpay also offers Enterprise/custom pricing for high-volume clients.

faqs.a: Razorpay provides payments infrastructure and financial tools to businesses: payments (gateway), subscriptions, payouts, and corporate banking services.

faqs.q: Do you have a free tier?
faqs.a: Razorpay typically uses a pay-as-you-go model with no setup fees for the standard plan. There is a sandbox/test mode for integrations but production transactions have per-transaction charges.
Startups, ecommerce merchants, SMEs, enterprise customers, and developers who need payment processing, subscription billing, payouts, or banking APIs.
Use Razorpay sandbox environment and generate test API keys. No money is deducted in test mode.
Yes — Enterprise/custom pricing and SLAs are available for high-volume businesses and are handled via a sales or account team.
